# ApkUp

> Open-source, privacy-first multi-source Android app updater (GPL-3.0) supporting Google Play, F-Droid Index V2, IzzyOnDroid, APKMirror, GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, and direct APK links — with optional silent background installations via Shizuku (no root) or Root (su), zero ads, and zero tracking.

- Latest version: v1.46.0 (231)
- Platform: Android 10.0 – 17 (API 29+) • arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64
- Languages: 9 UI languages (English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese-BR, Russian, Turkish)
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
- Source Code: https://github.com/DurchEins/apkup
- Complete AI Knowledge Base (single-file Markdown): https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/llms-full.txt

## Main Pages

- [Home & Feature Overview](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/): Overview of all 8 update sources, 10 app screenshots, Shizuku/Root silent updates, signed APK download, SHA-256 verification, and Android permissions matrix.
- [Downloads, Mirrors & SHA-256 Verification](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/downloads/): Canonical signed APK download, live SHA256SUMS checksums, ABI/Android requirements, and all 8 official & community mirrors.
- [Install Unknown Apps (APK Sideloading Guide)](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/sideloading/): Step-by-step Android 10–17 sideloading instructions and power-user paths via Shizuku, ADB, and Root.
- [Google's 24h Sideloading Lock & Keep Android Open](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/sideloading/google-lock/): Permanent unlock guide for Google's 2026/2027 24-hour Developer Options cooldown, user impact, and Keep Android Open campaign.
- [Wiki & Reference Guides](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/wiki/): Complete 12-chapter documentation covering source priority, F-Droid Index V2, PAT tokens, Shizuku & Root setup, Obtainium JSON import, sideloading, Google's 24h lock, and error troubleshooting.
- [Source Compatibility & Comparison](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/compare/): Feature comparison (ApkUp vs. Obtainium vs. Aurora Store vs. F-Droid) and 100% offline Obtainium JSON compatibility checker.
- [What's New / Changelog](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/changelog/): Release history and feature highlights.
- [Privacy Policy](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/privacy/): Zero-telemetry, on-device storage, and encrypted credential details.
- [Security Policy](https://durcheins.github.io/apkup/security/): Supported versions, SHA-256 verification, and vulnerability disclosure.
